critical_boundaries: Hilt discovered unidentified; later Carrie identification/return supersedes historical cutoff without backdating recognition
Stone/metal appearance not a verified alloy composition; nonsentient assessment and incomplete mechanism retained
Carrie red spark versus Koh cyan projection; table and finger tests demonstrate psychic harm without ordinary cuts
Scion warning is attributed testimony, not a proven conspiracy
Flameskull psychic kill separate from holy-water ash and two garnets, no universal immunity bypass
S1E07 hilt crumbles; later two-blade and ranged abilities persist independently, no new hilt or retroactive early power
Partial Snake Island memory does not resolve falling patrons fate or curse; activation/defense and successful dual hits remain distinct
Unreferenced Sun Blade speculation is now attached to status but still unconfirmed production talk
Longsword forged after actual gold sacrifice; potato burns, failed ball-bearing/candle attempts not additional weapons
Golden appearance does not establish full metallurgy or potato ornament; exact written item properties unverified
S2E08 actual hit wounds living dragon; S2E09 omitted conclusion is GM retrospective with Marsh arrow finishing blow, no new played sword strike
Last explicit sword custody Evelyn after expedition; later transforming blade does not prove conversion/disposal of this weapon
